issues.location: regularization induction on dirty eigenvariable inferences
issues.finding: Choosing an arbitrary highest eigenvariable inference may choose a clean one and fail to decrease the induction measure. Above a highest dirty inference there may still be clean inferences, and renaming can decrease the dirty count by more than one.
issues.proposed_resolution: Choose a highest dirty inference, note that all eigenvariable inferences in its upper subproof are clean, and conclude that at most n-minus-one dirty inferences remain; scope the exercise to that choice.
